Posterior within-time cross-feature covariance

Source: R/postprocess.R
posterior_Sigma.Rd

Computes the posterior mean of the within-time cross-feature covariance \(\Sigma_t = \Lambda \Lambda^\top + \sigma^2_t I_J\) at each timepoint.

Usage

posterior_Sigma(fit, timepoint = NULL)

Arguments

fit

A fitted object returned by lodi().

timepoint

Optional integer in 1:T. If given, returns a J x J matrix for that timepoint; otherwise returns a J x J x T array with the posterior mean at every timepoint.

Value

Either a J x J matrix or a J x J x T array.
